card_id.description: Card ID to check for duplicates

index_size.description: Number of cards in FAISS index

card_id.description: Research card ID to match against templates

max_templates.description: Maximum number of templates to return

card_id.description: Research card ID that was matched

matching_templates.description: List of matching templates sorted by score (highest first)

card_affinity.description: The research card's canonical affinity used for matching

scheduler_running.description: Whether scheduler dispatch loop is running

current_task_id.description: Currently executing task ID (null if none)

has_active_reservation.description: Whether a Direct API reservation is active

run_recovery.description: Whether to run crash recovery on startup

recovery_stats.description: Recovery statistics if recovery was run

timeout.description: Maximum wait time for current task to complete (seconds)

accepted.description: Whether story was accepted by quality filter

research_used.description: List of research card IDs used
List of research card IDs used

topic.description: Story topic. If provided, searches for matching research card or auto-generates one.

tags.description: Custom tags to include. Merged with auto-generated tags (default: ['호러', 'horror'])

auto_research.description: Auto-generate research if no matching card found for topic

model.description: Story model. Options: null (Claude Sonnet default), 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', 'claude-opus-4-5-20251101', 'ollama:qwen3:30b' (local Ollama)

research_model.description: Research model for auto-research. Options: null/'qwen3:30b' (Ollama), 'gemini', 'deep-research' (Gemini Deep Research)

target_length.description: Target story length in characters (soft limit, ±10%). If not provided, uses default (~3000-4000 chars).

thumbnail_provider.description: Image provider for thumbnail. Options: 'openai_dalle3' (default), 'stability_ai', 'flux', 'local_sd'. Requires ENABLE_THUMBNAIL_GENERATION=true.

story.description: Full story text in markdown format

webhook_triggered.description: Whether a webhook notification was triggered

thumbnail_url.description: URL of generated thumbnail image (empty if disabled or failed)

thumbnail_provider.description: Image provider used for thumbnail generation

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout before model unload (0 = disabled)

active_models.description: Map of model name to last used timestamp

type.description: Task type: 'story' for story generation, 'research' for research generation
Task type: 'story' for story generation, 'research' for research generation
